subject: RE: somewhere to sell

agentStart.when: The player asks the agent to build a marketplace, classifieds or listing site where people sell items, such as Swaplist. No client or feature list needed: nobody hires the player for this one.

body: A user app nobody hires you for: ask the agent to build the simple listing site Viktor asked for on Y. Listings with a photo and a price, search, a way to contact the seller, and marking things sold.

outcomes.when: the player asks the agent to build a classifieds marketplace or listing site
outcomes.reply: Thank you. Truly. I'll list the watch the moment it's up.

hints: Ask the agent to build a listing site for Viktor.
